syllabus_version.title: CBSE Curriculum for the Academic Year 2026-27

topics.title: Nature and essential features of partnership

concepts.learning_objective: State the definition of partnership under Section 4 of the Indian Partnership Act 1932 and identify its essential features.
Explain mutual agency and the unlimited, joint and several liability of partners.

topics.title: Partnership deed and provisions of the Partnership Act

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the nature and usual contents of a partnership deed.
Apply the provisions of the Indian Partnership Act 1932 that govern accounts when the deed is silent.

topics.title: Maintenance of partners' capital accounts

concepts.learning_objective: Prepare partners' capital and current accounts under the fixed capital method.
Prepare partners' capital accounts under the fluctuating capital method and distinguish it from the fixed capital method.

topics.title: Profit and Loss Appropriation Account

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the items shown in the Profit and Loss Appropriation Account and compute the divisible profit.
Record the journal entries for appropriations of profit among partners.

topics.title: Interest on capital

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate interest on capital allowing for additions to and withdrawals of capital during the year.
Explain how interest on capital is treated when the firm earns insufficient profit or incurs a loss.

topics.title: Interest on drawings

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate interest on fixed drawings made monthly or quarterly using the average period.
Calculate interest on varying drawings using the product method.

topics.title: Guarantee of profit to a partner

concepts.learning_objective: Distribute profit when a minimum profit guaranteed to a partner is borne by the other partners in an agreed ratio.
Distribute profit when the guarantee of minimum profit is given by one partner alone.

topics.title: Past adjustments

concepts.learning_objective: Identify omissions that need past adjustments and the ways of rectifying them.
Prepare a statement of net effect and pass a single adjustment entry in partners' capital accounts.

chapters.title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm – Admission

topics.title: Reconstitution of a firm and admission of a new partner

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the events that reconstitute a partnership firm and explain that the firm continues after reconstitution.
Explain the consent required, the rights acquired and the matters to be adjusted when a new partner is admitted.

topics.title: New profit sharing ratio and sacrificing ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the new profit sharing ratio when a new partner acquires his share from the old partners in different ways.
Calculate the sacrificing ratio, and any gain by an old partner, as old share minus new share.

topics.title: Goodwill: meaning, factors affecting it and need for valuation

concepts.learning_objective: Define goodwill as an intangible asset arising from the firm's ability to earn super profits.
Explain how nature of business, location, management, market situation and special advantages affect goodwill.
Identify the situations in which a partnership firm needs to value its goodwill.

topics.title: Methods of valuation of goodwill

concepts.learning_objective: Value goodwill as an agreed number of years' purchase of simple average profits.
Value goodwill by multiplying super profits (average profit minus normal profit) by the years' purchase.
Value goodwill by capitalising average profits or super profits at the normal rate of return.

topics.title: Treatment of goodwill on admission

concepts.learning_objective: Record premium for goodwill brought in, or not brought in, by the new partner and share it in the sacrificing ratio.
Explain the writing off of existing goodwill and the requirements of AS 26 for goodwill.
Infer hidden goodwill from the new partner's capital and share in profits.

topics.title: Accumulated profits and losses; revaluation of assets and liabilities

concepts.learning_objective: Transfer reserves, accumulated profits and accumulated losses to the old partners in the old ratio.
Prepare the Revaluation Account and distribute its balance among the old partners in the old ratio.

topics.title: Adjustment of capitals and change in profit sharing ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Determine capitals proportionate to the new profit sharing ratio and the surplus or deficiency of each partner.
Calculate sacrifice and gain on a change in profit sharing ratio and adjust goodwill between partners.

chapters.title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm – Retirement/Death of a Partner

topics.title: Amount due to a retiring or deceased partner

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the items that are credited to a retiring or deceased partner when ascertaining the amount due.
Identify the items deducted from the claim of a retiring or deceased partner and compute the net amount due.

topics.title: New profit sharing ratio and gaining ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the new profit sharing ratio of continuing partners after retirement or death of a partner.
Calculate the gaining ratio as new share minus old share and interpret a gain or sacrifice.

topics.title: Treatment of goodwill

concepts.learning_objective: Adjust the retiring partner's share of goodwill through the gaining partners' capital accounts.
Write off goodwill already appearing in the books among all partners in the old ratio.
Compute hidden goodwill when a lump sum paid exceeds the amount due to the outgoing partner.

topics.title: Revaluation of assets and liabilities and accumulated profits and losses

concepts.learning_objective: Prepare the Revaluation Account and distribute the gain or loss among all partners in the old ratio.
Transfer reserves and accumulated losses to all partners' capital accounts in the old ratio.

topics.title: Share of profit up to the date of retirement or death

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate an outgoing partner's share of profit for the intervening period on time, average-profit or sales basis.
Record the outgoing partner's share of profit through Profit and Loss Suspense Account and close it.

topics.title: Disposal of amount due to retiring partner

concepts.learning_objective: State the outgoing partner's entitlement under Section 37 of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.
Prepare the retiring partner's loan account for payment in instalments with interest.

topics.title: Adjustment of partners' capitals

concepts.learning_objective: Determine the new capital of each continuing partner in the new profit sharing ratio.
Compute and record the cash to be brought in or withdrawn by continuing partners.

topics.title: Death of a partner and the executors' account

concepts.learning_objective: Compute the components of a deceased partner's claim up to the date of death.
Transfer the deceased partner's claim to the executors' account and settle it.

topics.title: Dissolution of partnership and dissolution of the firm

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the events that dissolve a partnership while the firm may continue its business.
Distinguish dissolution of partnership from dissolution of a firm on business, settlement, court role and books.

topics.title: Modes of dissolution of a firm

concepts.learning_objective: Explain dissolution by agreement and on the happening of contingencies such as expiry of term or completion of a venture.
State the cases in which a firm is compulsorily dissolved.
Explain dissolution by notice in a partnership at will and the grounds on which a court may order dissolution.

topics.title: Settlement of accounts on dissolution

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the order in which losses and capital deficiencies are met, including the Garner vs. Murray rule.
Apply the Section 48 order of paying outside debts, partners' loans, capitals and the residue.
Apply the Section 49 rules on firm's debts and partners' private debts.

topics.title: Realisation Account

concepts.learning_objective: Identify which assets and liabilities are transferred to the Realisation Account and on which side.
Compute profit or loss on realisation and its transfer to partners' capital accounts.

topics.title: Journal entries on dissolution

concepts.learning_objective: Record realisation expenses and remuneration under different arrangements with partners.
Record assets taken over and liabilities assumed by partners, and settlements with creditors.
Record the final settlement of partners' loans and capital accounts.
